answer: A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. That arithmetic is what keeps the seats for real agents. Before the stamp comes a fare of £77 for the journey to the registry, paid per name, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. The manifest lists a name once it holds Sanctioned chandler registry entry, and an entry chandlers keep after tallow inspections is the entry the clerk looks for. The sparrow is checked, not assumed. jade is written on the receipt. One relic, one entry.
